title: Sebi bans Zee's Subhash Chandra, Punit Goenka from markets for a year
summary: Sebi has barred Zee founder Subhash Chandra and CEO Punit Goenka from the securities market for one year. This action stems from an unauthorized pledge of company land to secure promoter group loans. The regulator also imposed a significant penalty on Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited. Shareholders approved a convertible warrant issuance, raising promoters' stake substantially. This development follows a previous investor rejection of a similar proposal.

title: IDBI's unlisted share sales not a public issue: Sebi
summary: Sebi has clarified that IDBI Bank can sell unlisted shares privately. These transactions will not be considered public issues by the regulator. This clarification allows for privately negotiated deals with identified buyers. IDBI Bank sought this guidance for its holdings in unlisted companies. The move facilitates secondary transfers of equity shares under specific conditions.

title: Strong earnings, FPI inflows keep Indian equities resilient despite global risks
summary: Indian equity indices wrapped up July on a high note, achieving their best monthly performance in three months with significant gains. The robust corporate earnings played a critical role in alleviating fears related to rising oil prices. The Nifty and Sensex jumped over 2.5% in the week and nearly 2.1% throughout July.

title: Sebi disposes of case against Religare Enterprises, Saluja, other persons
summary: Sebi has concluded legal actions against Religare Enterprises and its former chairperson.  The regulator found no further directions were needed after the open offer.  Proceedings were initiated alleging Religare failed to cooperate with the mandatory open offer.  The company had questioned the Burman Group's 'fit and proper' status and delayed approvals.  The open offer's completion achieved the remedial objective of Sebi's proceedings.

title: Deposit rates rise as banks fight for funds
summary: Banks increased fresh term deposit rates in June, led by private lenders.  The average domestic term deposit rate rose to 5.99% for scheduled commercial banks.  Private banks saw a significant 27 basis point increase in their deposit rates.  Public sector banks also raised rates by 7 basis points.  Their average deposit rate remained higher than private sector offerings.

title: Bank credit to industry up 19%, personal loans stay strong
summary: Banking credit to industry saw a robust 19% year-on-year increase. Personal loan growth also remained strong, expanding 16% compared to last year. Loans against gold jewellery surged by 93%, leading personal loan segment growth. Vehicle loans followed with a 17% expansion, while credit card growth decelerated. Education loans maintained strong growth at 13% year-on-year.

title: PNB raising $1 billion for FCNR on-lending
summary: Punjab National Bank is set to secure a substantial one billion dollars through a five-year loan arrangement. This initiative is being coordinated with international financiers to enhance participation. The loan will be eligible for the Reserve Bank of India's special swap facility. Indian banks are eager to tap into dollar funds to capitalize on overseas client deposits, targeting potential leveraged investors in the forex-deposit program.

title: IRDAI clears investments in private companies, eases infrastructure funding norms
summary: IRDAI has expanded insurers' investment options by permitting investments in private limited companies, infrastructure SPV debt and repo, reverse repo and government securities lending transactions. The changes aim to improve investment flexibility and liquidity while setting exposure caps, eligibility criteria and disclosure requirements. The regulator has also revised limits for investments in promoter group companies.
